description: Retrieves a list of teams with explicit access to a specific project within a Sentry organization.

inputSchema.description: Input to retrieve teams associated with a Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry project.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: RetrieveProjectTeamsRequest

name: retrieve_project_teams

RetrieveProjectTeamsResponse.description: Output of listing teams associated with a Sentry project.

data.description: List of teams that have access to the specified project. Each team includes details such as ID, slug, name, member count, permissions, and avatar information.
data.title: Data

RetrieveProjectTeamsResponse.title: RetrieveProjectTeamsResponse

access.description: List of access permissions the team has (e.g., 'project:read', 'project:write', 'alerts:read').
access.title: Access

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the team was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

hasAccess.description: Whether the authenticated user has access to this team.
hasAccess.title: Has Access

isMember.description: Whether the authenticated user is a member of this team.
isMember.title: Is Member

isPending.description: Whether the team membership is pending approval.
isPending.title: Is Pending

memberCount.description: Number of members in this team.
memberCount.title: Member Count

teamRole.description: Role of the authenticated user in this team (e.g., 'admin', 'contributor'), or null if not a member.
teamRole.title: Team Role

avatarUuid.description: UUID of the avatar image, if custom avatar is set.
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid
